report:
Reviewed the complete crate_ownership claim and all four ordinary implementation associations and three ordinary tests. workspace.rs chooses the nearest enclosing manifest by its declared crate name and constructs namespaces from that name plus declaration paths. validate.rs requires crate.sage placement, rejects orphan or undeclared/misplaced modules, and builds entity identities without directory spelling. correspondence.rs loads Cargo workspace sources, requires model correspondences and rejects mappings to a different Rust crate. book.rs runs model/correspondence validation before publication and computes chapter routes from physical paths separately from model namespaces. These account for manifest boundaries, Rust ownership verification, and identity preservation when only the book directory moves.

All associated assertions were independently reassessed: invalid_models_and_correspondence_fail_before_publishing_an_explorer checks invalid type, missing Rust correspondence, and wrong Rust owner with failure, diagnostic, empty stdout and absent asset; orphan_sage_module_and_nonexistent_rust_crate_are_rejected checks both ownership failures and prevents publication; relocating_crate_sources_preserves_model_identity_and_updates_book_routes moves demo to compiler/frontend and asserts exact stable namespace/entity sets and Rust targets while chapter paths, navigation and relative explorer routes change. Captured Fixture/chapters and script_data helpers establish real subprocess preprocessing and extraction of generated JSON. Collectively these would detect using directory names as entity identities or accepting invalid ownership. No TODO/N/A entries or deferral prerequisites exist.

Baseline verification: all four implementation files, complete claim, implementation metadata, test metadata and all three complete test bodies exactly match the historical input. The changed surrounding book tests migrate review APIs/status assertions and claim-fragment access; their diff does not alter this anchor's tests or helpers. Historical rationale remains sufficient after current source reassessment, rather than approval by annotation. Commands executed here: review start/read, source/baseline comparison and review record; no functional tests or workspace build rerun. The coordinator separately reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and cargo build passed; that is reported execution, not execution by this reviewer. No edits required.
